    score = observation.get("scores", [0, 0]) or [0, 0]
    sp = score[0] if len(score) > 0 else 0
    op = score[1] if len(score) > 1 else 0

    blocked = set()
    for p in obs:
        if isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) and len(p) >= 2:
            blocked.add((p[0], p[1]))

    best = None
    bestv = None
    if res:
        for p in res:
            if not isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) or len(p) < 2:
                continue
            x, y = p[0], p[1]
            d = abs(x - sx) + abs(y - sy)
            od = abs(x - ox) + abs(y - oy) if isinstance(ox, int) else d + 1
            v = (d, od, abs(x - w // 2) + abs(y - h // 2))

    dx = dy = 0
    if best is not None:

        dx = 0 if bx == sx else (1 if bx > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if by == sy else (1 if by > sy else -1)
        if abs(bx - sx) > abs(by - sy):

        elif abs(by - sy) > abs(bx - sx):

    else:

        dy = 1 if sy * 2 < h - 1 else (-1 if sy * 2 > h - 1 else 0)

    cand = [(dx, dy), (dx, 0), (0, dy), (1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 0)]
    for a, b in cand:
        nx, ny = sx + a, sy + b
